purpose: Publish a completed, source-verified crew field key for Beetle spurge without mislabeling its large, striped hairy capsules as mature seeds and without pretending exact curled gland-fringe substructure is already photographed.

photos.rights: Eric Knight photo-specific CC BY; obatalov, debm, creamnosugar and yamstress photo-specific CC BY-NC (noncommercial education with creator/source links).
diagnostic_evidence: White woolly flowering clusters and large mottled hairy actual green 3-lobed capsules
gaps: Dedicated macro showing 5–12 individual densely hairy white appendage fringes folding inward over the actual gland
Mature real 2.8–4.1mm detached pitted/tuberculate seed and caruncle with scale

genus_comparison: FNA-backed E. exstipulata text key tightened: noticeably toothed leaves and fringed gland appendages not incurved to cover gland. No fake look-alike photo substitutions.
nonreproducible_reference: https://www.phytoneuron.net/2015Phytoneuron/26PhytoN-SWArizFlora13.pdf (Figure 26D photos scientifically relevant but reuse rights unconfirmed, no redisplay)
native_range: No Hays County native claim; paused BONAP/NAPA audit intentionally not re-run
